thread.title: Brokerages Anticipate Apple (AAPL) Will Post Quarterly Sales of $61.42 Billion

author: ABMN Staff
title: Brokerages Anticipate Apple (AAPL) Will Post Quarterly Sales of $61.42 Billion
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Apr 1st, 2018 // No Comments 
Wall Street analysts expect that Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) will announce sales of $61.42 billion for the current fiscal quarter, Zacks Investment Research reports. Seven analysts have made estimates for Apple’s earnings, with estimates ranging from $60.99 billion to $61.81 billion. Apple posted sales of $52.90 billion in the same quarter last year, which suggests a positive year over year growth rate of 16.1%. The firm is scheduled to issue its next quarterly earnings report on Tuesday, May 1st. 
According to Zacks, analysts expect that Apple will report full year sales of $61.42 billion for the current financial year, with estimates ranging from $253.19 billion to $267.79 billion. For the next fiscal year, analysts expect that the firm will post sales of $264.18 billion per share, with estimates ranging from $240.25 billion to $275.32 billion. Zacks’ sales calculations are an average based on a survey of research analysts that that provide coverage for Apple. Get Apple alerts: 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating the consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. During the same period in the previous year, the company posted $3.36 earnings per share. The company’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. AAPL has been the topic of several research reports. Macquarie set a $188.00 price target on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Friday, January 26th. ValuEngine upgraded Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating in a research note on Sunday, December 31st. Barclays lowered their price target on Apple from $170.00 to $168.00 and set an “equal weight” rating on the stock in a research note on Friday, March 16th. Zacks Investment Research upgraded Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $197.00 price target on the stock in a research note on Thursday, January 18th. Finally, Piper Jaffray restated a “buy” rating and set a $200.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, January 2nd. One investment analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have given a hold rating, thirty-two have given a buy rating and one has given a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $202.62.
Shares of NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $167.78 on Friday. Apple has a 12-month low of $140.06 and a 12-month high of $183.50. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a current ratio of 1.24. The stock has a market cap of $851,317.94, a P/E ratio of 18.22, a PEG ratio of 1.27 and a beta of 1.19. 
In other Apple news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Friday, January 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total transaction of $2,733,733.98. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now owns 13,739 shares in the company, valued at approximately $2,401,302.42. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is accessible through this hyperlink . Insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock. 
Institutional investors and hedge funds have recently added to or reduced their stakes in the stock. Janus Henderson Group PLC boosted its stake in Apple by 301.3% in the 2nd quarter. Janus Henderson Group PLC now owns 20,003,587 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,880,992,000 after purchasing an additional 15,018,790 shares during the period. Amundi Pioneer Asset Management Inc. boosted its stake in Apple by 50.7% in the 4th quarter. Amundi Pioneer Asset Management Inc. now owns 13,228,306 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,238,624,000 after purchasing an additional 4,448,509 shares during the period. Truepoint Inc. boosted its stake in Apple by 15,559.4% in the 3rd quarter. Truepoint Inc. now owns 4,436,774 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,437,000 after purchasing an additional 4,408,441 shares during the period. Capital Research Global Investors boosted its stake in Apple by 15.0% in the 2nd quarter. Capital Research Global Investors now owns 29,449,961 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,241,383,000 after purchasing an additional 3,845,363 shares during the period. Finally, Stifel Financial Corp boosted its stake in Apple by 9,166.4% in the 3rd quarter. Stifel Financial Corp now owns 3,883,754 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $598,497,000 after purchasing an additional 3,841,842 shares during the period. About Apple

The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
